description: The closed set of model ids the REVIEW capability may resolve to on a model-id provider. Policy, owned by architect-cto: a review's failure mode is a green PR that merges, so the reviewer's model is never a cost decision. tools/fabric/lint.py refuses a committed profile whose merged review model is outside this set, and runtime/openrouter/launch refuses the MERGED result at launch (the local override layer is where a cheap-reviewer experiment would otherwise sneak in). Coding classes — code-low, code-medium, code-high — are not gated by this file. Add a router or preset here only after a live test has shown the harness forwards that reference verbatim.
